name: creditsync
description: Private CreditSync borrower, payment, loan settlement/restructure, waiver, disbursement, renewal, and reversal workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Review and manage private CreditSync workflows.
interface.longDescription: Use the private CreditSync app to resolve borrowers, settle and restructure single-payment loans, waive eligible components, manage floating interest, post payments and disbursements, renew daily loans, and create audited reversals.
defaultPrompt: Find a borrower and show outstanding loans.
Preview a single-payment loan settlement and replacement contract.
Record a loan disbursement with evidence.
Schedule a future floating-loan interest rate.
